newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop says part of E.Point offer sold.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop says part of E.Point offer sold.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties said 52 flats out of the latest batch of 215 units on offer at the East Point City residential development in Tseung Kwan O in the New Territories were sold on the first day of sale on Wednesday.

"The (latest) sale of East Point City flats reflects that the property market is gradually becoming stable after the government announced measures to steady prices," a Sun Hung Kai Properties spokeswoman said by telephone.
"And most buyers of the East Point City flats (in the latest sale) are end users, we expect speculative activities will be further reduced," the spokeswoman said.
There were 254 potential buyers registered to buy the last batch of 215 flats of the development, the spokeswoman said.
The units, which range from 588 to 796 square feet, were offered at an average price of HK$6,500 a square foot.
